title: Minnesota Fraud Research Claim
description: Atomic unit of the MinnesotaPeace evidence corpus. Extended from the committed GitHub claim.schema.json on branch research/minnesota-fraud-corpus (required fields, evidence_class, original lowercase status values, and original metric_type values are preserved so previously written claim files remain valid). A claim is not an article. Public wording must reflect status. Do not write 'X stole $14 million' when the evidence only supports 'prosecutors alleged that X participated in a scheme involving approximately $14 million'.

idString.description: Durable identifier. Never use a display name as a key.

evidenceClass.description: Evidentiary class of the supporting record. An indictment is CHARGED_ALLEGED (what prosecutors alleged), not ADJUDICATED. An official source is not independently proven merely because it is official.

metricType.description: Dollar figures are not interchangeable. amount_billed ≠ amount_paid ≠ alleged_loss ≠ proven_loss ≠ restitution_ordered ≠ recovered_amount. Never collapse figures into a headline TOTAL FRAUD number. The circulating '$9 billion' Minnesota Medicaid figure is a fraud_estimate or investigative hypothesis, not proven_loss.

exactOrApproximate.description: Whether the amount is a precise figure from the source or an approximation/rounding.

grossOrNet.description: Whether the amount is gross or net of offsets, recoveries, or other adjustments.

source_id.description: Source identifier of the supporting document.

page.description: Page number or page range (e.g. 14 or '14-16') in the cited document.

quote.description: Verbatim supporting passage. Prefer exact source language over paraphrase.

locator.description: Optional non-page locator (paragraph, Bates number, PDF destination, transcript timestamp).

value.description: Numeric amount. Original field name; do not rename.

period_start.description: Inclusive start of the period the amount covers.

period_end.description: Inclusive end of the period the amount covers.

methodology.description: How the figure was derived, if the source states a method.

overlap_group_id.description: Identifier grouping amounts that must not be summed because they overlap (e.g. a program-wide estimate that already contains charged-case amounts).

assertionLadder.description: For major or controversial claims, show how far the evidence actually goes. Example: claim 'officials knowingly facilitated fraud' may have evidence of complaints received, inadequate investigations, and continued payments, while missing evidence that a specified official knowingly joined the scheme. Current assessment might then be: strong evidence of oversight failure; insufficient evidence for criminal participation by specified officials.

claim.description: The controversial or high-stakes formulation being tested.

evidence_available.description: What the record actually shows, each item sourced elsewhere in this claim.

missing_evidence.description: What would be required to support a stronger formulation and is not yet in the corpus.

current_assessment.description: Qualified assessment that preserves A–E proposition boundaries.

claim_text.description: Atomic, testable statement as currently formulated.

normalized_claim.description: Optional canonical restatement used for comparison, search, and contradiction detection.

claim_type.description: Optional classification of the kind of proposition.

subject_ids.description: Original field. Entity IDs this claim is about.

status.description: Lifecycle / legal status of the proposition. Lowercase values (confirmed, adjudicated, charged, alleged, disputed, superseded, withdrawn, unresolved) are the original schema and remain valid. Uppercase values are mandate extensions. Public-facing wording must reflect this status. Preserve historical progression via valid_from / valid_until / superseded_by rather than overwriting history.

proposition_class.description: A–E epistemic class. These are not interchangeable. A = private actors intentionally defrauded government-funded programs. B = agency failed to prevent, identify, stop, investigate, or respond. C = negligence, incompetence, misadministration, or policy failure. D = an individual official knowingly violated a legal/ethical/administrative duty. E = a public official knowingly participated in criminal conduct. Evidence of B does not establish C; C does not establish D; D does not establish E. Never collapse B or C into D/E without actor-specific evidence.

event_date.description: Original field. Principal date of the claimed event, if a single date applies.

date_start.description: Inclusive start of the claimed period (extends event_date for ranges).

date_end.description: Inclusive end of the claimed period.

source_ids.description: Identifiers of sources that support this claim.

source_locator.description: Original field. Free-text locator within a source when supporting_passages is not used.

supporting_passages.description: Exact supporting text/pages bound to source_ids. Quality gate 2 (Passage).

case_number.description: Original field. Court case / docket number if applicable.

persons.description: Person entity_ids named in this claim.

programs.description: Program entity_ids (may overlap program_ids; both are valid).

cases.description: Case IDs this claim relates to.

events.description: Event IDs this claim relates to.

amounts.description: Original field, extended with exact_or_approximate, gross_or_net, overlap_group_id.

corroborating_source_ids.description: Original field. Additional sources that independently corroborate.

contradicting_claim_ids.description: Original field. Claim IDs that conflict with this one.

qualifiers.description: Scope, hedging, or caveats that must travel with the claim (e.g. 'as of indictment date', 'settlement contains no-determination language').

confidence.description: How strongly the available record supports this formulation of the claim. A numeric 0–1 score (original schema) or a qualitative enum. Confidence does not replace legal/evidentiary status: 'high confidence prosecutors alleged X' is not 'high confidence X occurred'.

is_allegation.description: True if the claim restates an allegation rather than an adjudicated fact.

is_inference.description: True if the claim is a derived analytical conclusion. Must never masquerade as a source fact.

editorial_notes.description: Internal notes. Not a substitute for sourced claim_text.

reviewed_at.description: When this claim was last human- or agent-reviewed.

valid_from.description: Start of the temporal state this record describes. Never overwrite history.

valid_until.description: End of the temporal state. Null means currently valid.

superseded_by.description: claim_id of the record that replaces this one (plea superseding allegation, later count, correction).
